texts.preamble: S.Mariselvam vs The Secretary To Government Of Tamil ... on 18 July, 2025 Author: S.Srimathy Bench: S.Srimathy Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 18.07.2025 Coram: The Honourable Mrs.Justice S.Srimathy W.P(MD)No.18117 of 2025 S.Mariselvam .. Vs 1 . The Secretary to Government of Tamil Nadu, Secretariat, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Fort St. George, Chennai. 2. The Commissioner, Office of the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administrtion Department , 359, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai. 3. The District Collector, Erode, Erode District. 4. The Food Safety Officer, Food Safety Office , Erode Collectorate Campus, Near the Sbi Bank, Erode, Erode District. S.Mariselvam vs The Secretary To Government Of Tamil ... on 18 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18483777/ 1 1/5 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 10/09/2025 11:23:23 am ) 5. The Lavanya Snacks, Mani Complex 1 Nagaratchi Nagar, Solar, Erode District. 6. The Manager,, Jayakumaran Super Market, Othakkadai, Erode District. Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Indi praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondent Nos.1 take appropriate action against the respondent Nos.5 and 6, based on the petitioner's representation dated 30.12.2023. For Petitioner : Mr.V.Kishore Kumar For R-1 to R-4 : Mr.K.S.Selva Ganesan Additional Government Pleader For R-5 & R-6 : Mr.O.R.Gokul Abimanyu Order
